description: VSL Funnel Tracker — Server-Side GTM Container for Meta CAPI Bridge. Deploy to stape.io, Google Cloud Run, or App Engine.
notes: This server container receives events from the web container's GA4 tag
and forwards them to Meta's Conversions API for server-side tracking.
1. Create a Server container in GTM (tagmanager.google.com)
2. Deploy to stape.io ($10-30/mo) or Google Cloud Run (~$5-15/mo)
3. Import this JSON into the server container
4. Update the Meta CAPI Access Token variable
1. Receives GA4 events from the web container
2. Forwards them to Meta CAPI with hashed user data
3. Uses the same event_id for deduplication with browser pixel

client.name: GA4 Client
client.notes: Receives measurement protocol hits from GA4 web tag

tag.name: Meta CAPI - Lead Event
tag.notes: Install the 'Facebook Conversions API Tag' template from GTM Community Gallery. Configure: Pixel ID, Access Token, event_name=Lead, event_id from GA4 event parameter, user_data (hashed email, phone, ip, user_agent).

tag.name: Meta CAPI - Custom Video Events
tag.notes: Forwards VideoStart, Video25/50/75Percent, VideoComplete to CAPI

variable.name: CAPI - Pixel ID
variable.notes: Replace with your Meta Pixel ID

variable.name: CAPI - Access Token
variable.notes: Generate in Meta Business Settings > System Users > Generate Token with ads_management permission
